name: comp-181
title: Switch With Icon Label
description: A switch with a small sun or crescent moon beside it that follows the switch state, shown three times in an Appearance card of theme rows. The knob slides and the icon swaps in the same motion.
use: For a light and dark mode setting, when a sun or moon should show the live state beside the switch.
avoid: The meaning sits in the icon, so reusing it for an unrelated setting leaves the switch ambiguous.
a11y: The sun and moon are hidden from assistive tech and the switch is named only Toggle switch, so the icon state has no spoken equivalent. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card titled Appearance holds a grey subtitle and three rows split by faint rules. Each row puts a bold name and a grey description on the left and a small pill switch with a 16px sun or crescent on the right.
behaves: Clicking a switch slides its knob to the other end, darkens the track when off and replaces the sun with a crescent moon. The clip flips Interface, then Code blocks, and each switch is independent.
customise: The sun and moon imports, the starting state and the switch size are written in the file, and it takes no props. Edit the icons or the default there; the card and rows are demo code.
weight: light: One native switch with a sliding knob and a single icon that swaps.
